# GMSpritestrip89 v0.1.0 manifest

## Purpose
Standalone vendorable helper for GameMaker-style `_stripN` horizontal sprite strips.

## Public surface
- include/gmspritestrip89.h
- src/gmspritestrip89.c

## Vendored dependency
- vendor/SpriteAsset89_v0.1.2/

## Key behaviors
- parses `_stripN`
- makes clean logical asset names
- defines subimage clips through SpriteAsset89
- forwards image/render providers
